clause: Interactive-document objects model + buttons + form fields + MSO [STU-PRO-033,STU-PRO-034,STU-PRO-034a,STU-PRO-034b,STU-PRO-034c,STU-PRO-034d,STU-PRO-034e,STU-PRO-035,STU-PRO-036,STU-PRO-037,STU-PRO-038,STU-PRO-038a,STU-PRO-039]

scope.summary: Implement InDesign-class interactive-document objects as interactive roles on StudioLayer nodes (not a separate document silo) for interactive PDF, fixed/reflowable EPUB, and HTML, authored with the same selection/override/history surfaces: buttons with the event set (on release/tap, on click; on roll over/off; on focus/blur), the action set (navigation/PDF: go to destination/first/last/next/previous page, URL, next/previous view, open file, view zoom; show/hide & forms: show/hide buttons+forms, clear/print/submit form; media & state: animation, go to page, go to/next/previous state, sound, video), Normal/Rollover/Click appearance states + hidden-until-triggered, per-page tab order, and a sample library of preconfigured buttons/form elements; PDF form fields (check box, combo box, list box, radio button, signature, text) with the option set (description, required, printable, multiline, password, read-only, sort-items, export values); and multi-state objects (convert a selection into ordered states that add/reorder/delete, add-objects-to-state, paste-into-state, reset-all, hidden-until-triggered), driven by the button state actions.
acceptance_criteria: interactive roles on layers: buttons (events/actions/states/tab-order) + PDF form fields + MSO; author_ids + manual entry
expected_tests: argus: button editor + form-field editor + MSO panel reachable via author_ids

live: button events + action groups fire; Normal/Rollover/Click states + hidden-until-triggered; tab order; PDF form fields + options; MSO ordered states add/reorder/delete/paste-into/reset-all driven by state actions

target_entries: Studio / Interactive Documents / Buttons, forms and multi-state objects

risk_if_missed: No interactive-document objects; interactive PDF/EPUB/HTML authoring impossible.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
